title: Can a filer score stand in for the NVD
subtitle: Agreement between the filer's CVSS 3.1 vector and the NVD's, metric by metric and on the band

plan.title: Can a filer score stand in for the NVD
plan.population: CVEs scored by both the filer and the NVD, train, development and shadow windows only
plan.estimator: Cohen kappa per CVSS 3.1 base metric; quadratic weighted kappa on the severity band; by filer type; direction of disagreement
plan.prediction: substantial agreement on attack vector, weaker on privileges and scope
plan.interval: cluster bootstrap by filer, 2000 resamples, 95 percent

prediction_check: Kappa on attack vector 0.8435787657180237, on privileges required 0.6830406722462644, on scope 0.5377342552027463: attack vector agrees more than both.
method: Both vectors are the ones current at the data cut. Each base metric is compared as a category (Cohen kappa, unweighted); the band (None, Low, Medium, High, Critical, from the cvss library's base score) as an ordered scale (quadratic weighted kappa). The direction of disagreement is the share the filer rated worse less the share it rated milder, in severity order. Intervals are a cluster bootstrap by filer, 2,000 resamples, 95 percent, every statistic on the same draws; the direction tests form one Benjamini-Hochberg family at 0.05.
sql:
-- Q4: CVEs both the filer and the NVD scored with CVSS 3.1 (train, development and shadow
-- windows), how often each base metric and the band agree, by filer type.
select
    filer_type,
    count(*) as cves,
    avg(cast(nvd_av = filer_av as integer)) as agree_av,
    avg(cast(nvd_ac = filer_ac as integer)) as agree_ac,
    avg(cast(nvd_pr = filer_pr as integer)) as agree_pr,
    avg(cast(nvd_ui = filer_ui as integer)) as agree_ui,
    avg(cast(nvd_s = filer_s as integer)) as agree_s,
    avg(cast(nvd_c = filer_c as integer)) as agree_c,
    avg(cast(nvd_i = filer_i as integer)) as agree_i,
    avg(cast(nvd_a = filer_a as integer)) as agree_a,
    avg(cast(nvd_band = filer_band as integer)) as agree_band
